question: How many films are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film

question: How many customers are there?

question: List the titles of all films rated NC-17.
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating = 'NC-17'

question: How many actors have the first name Penelope?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor WHERE first_name ILIKE 'penelope'

question: What is the longest film length in minutes?
sql: SELECT MAX(length) FROM film

question: Which films cost more than 4 dollars to rent?
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rental_rate > 4

question: What is the average replacement cost of a film?
sql: SELECT AVG(replacement_cost) FROM film

question: What are the names of all film categories?
sql: SELECT name FROM category

question: Give me the first and last name of every staff member.
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM staff

question: What date and time was the very first rental made?

question: How many rentals have not been returned yet?

question: What is the total amount of all payments?

question: How many films can be rented for 7 days?

question: How many PG films run longer than two hours?

question: List the first 5 films alphabetically together with their language.
sql: SELECT f.title, l.name FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id ORDER BY f.title LIMIT 5

question: In which city is each store located?
sql: SELECT s.store_id, ci.city FROM store s JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id

question: Which actors star in the film ACADEMY DINOSAUR?
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: What category is the film ACADEMY DINOSAUR in?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: List the names of the customers who live in Canada.
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: How many customers does each store have?
sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY store_id

question: How much has Karl Seal paid in total?
sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.first_name ILIKE 'karl' AND c.last_name ILIKE 'seal'

question: For each staff member, how many payments did they process and what is the total amount?
sql: SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(p.payment_id), SUM(p.amount) FROM staff s JOIN payment p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

question: Which films have more than 6 copies in inventory across all stores?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 6

question: Which distinct films has Mary Smith rented?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.title FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE c.first_name ILIKE 'mary' AND c.last_name ILIKE 'smith'

question: Who manages each store and in which city is the store?
sql: SELECT s.store_id, st.first_name, st.last_name, ci.city FROM store s JOIN staff st ON s.manager_staff_id = st.staff_id JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id

question: Which distinct actors have appeared in a Sci-Fi film?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film_category fc ON fa.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Sci-Fi'

question: How many rentals were of Horror films?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: How many customers come from each country?
sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(*) FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country

question: Which customers have paid more than 200 dollars in total?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(p.amount) > 200

question: What is the average rental rate for each rating?
sql: SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: Which category has the most films?
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cat.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM category cat JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name) SELECT name FROM c WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM c)

question: How many films longer than 120 minutes does each category have?
sql: SELECT cat.name, COUNT(*) FROM category cat JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.length > 120 GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name

question: What was the total revenue in each month?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date), SUM(amount) FROM payment GROUP BY 1

question: Who are the 5 customers with the most rentals?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 5

question: How many distinct customers rented from each store's inventory?
sql: SELECT i.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY i.store_id

question: On average, how many rentals has each customer made?
sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) FROM rental

question: Which actor last names appear 4 or more times?
sql: SELECT last_name FROM actor GROUP BY last_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4

question: For each rating, what are the shortest, longest and average film lengths?
sql: SELECT rating, MIN(length), MAX(length), AVG(length) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: Which rating has the highest average replacement cost?
sql: SELECT rating FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY AVG(replacement_cost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have rented more than 30 films?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 30) t

question: What percentage of films are rated R?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 'R') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM film

question: What is the average rental rate in each category?
sql: SELECT cat.name, AVG(f.rental_rate) FROM category cat JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name

question: At which hour of the day do most rentals start?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM rental_date)::int FROM rental GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each category, which film earned the most revenue?
sql: WITH fr AS (SELECT cat.category_id, cat.name AS category, f.film_id, f.title, SUM(p.amount) AS rev FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name, f.film_id, f.title), rk AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rnk FROM fr) SELECT category, title FROM rk WHERE rnk = 1

question: What was the first film that each customer of store 2 ever rented?
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT r.customer_id, f.title, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.customer_id ORDER BY r.rental_date, r.rental_id) AS rn FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE c.store_id = 2) SELECT customer_id, title FROM x WHERE rn = 1

question: Which actors have appeared in both Comedy and Drama films but never in a Horror film?
sql: SELECT a.actor_id FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film_category fc ON fa.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy' INTERSECT SELECT a.actor_id FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film_category fc ON fa.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Drama' EXCEPT SELECT a.actor_id FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film_category fc ON fa.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: Which films have a rental rate above the average rental rate of the films in their own category?
sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id WHERE f.rental_rate > (SELECT AVG(f2.rental_rate) FROM film f2 JOIN film_category fc2 ON f2.film_id = fc2.film_id WHERE fc2.category_id = fc.category_id)

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total payments in each store?
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT c.store_id, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.store_id, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY total DESC, customer_id) AS rn FROM t) SELECT store_id, customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM r WHERE rn <= 3

question: Which categories have at least 5 films that were never rented?
sql: WITH fc AS (SELECT cat.category_id, cat.name, f.film_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) AS rented FROM category cat JOIN film_category x ON cat.category_id = x.category_id JOIN film f ON x.film_id = f.film_id) SELECT name FROM fc GROUP BY category_id, name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rented THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) >= 5

question: Which month had the highest revenue, and how much was it?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date), SUM(amount) FROM payment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many rentals were returned later than the film's allowed rental duration?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL AND r.return_date > r.rental_date + f.rental_duration * INTERVAL '1 day'

question: Which actors have never appeared in an R-rated film?
sql: SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE fa.actor_id = a.actor_id AND f.rating = 'R')

question: Which customers' very first rental was a film in the Action category?
sql: WITH fr AS (SELECT r.customer_id, i.film_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.customer_id ORDER BY r.rental_date, r.rental_id) AS rn FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id) SELECT fr.customer_id FROM fr JOIN film_category fc ON fr.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE fr.rn = 1 AND c.name = 'Action'

question: For each rating, how many films are longer than the average length of films with that rating?
sql: SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) FROM film f WHERE f.length > (SELECT AVG(f2.length) FROM film f2 WHERE f2.rating = f.rating) GROUP BY f.rating

question: Which four cities have the most rentals, going by the city of the customer?
sql: SELECT ci.city FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id GROUP BY ci.city_id, ci.city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ci.city_id LIMIT 4

question: How many customers rented at least one film in every month that appears in the rental data?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', rental_date)) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', rental_date)) FROM rental)) t

question: Which films have been rented more times than the average number of rentals per rented film?
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS c FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title) SELECT film_id, title FROM n WHERE c > (SELECT AVG(c) FROM n)

question: Which other actors have appeared in at least 4 films together with GINA DEGENERES?
sql: SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa2 ON a.actor_id = fa2.actor_id JOIN film_actor fa1 ON fa1.film_id = fa2.film_id JOIN actor g ON g.actor_id = fa1.actor_id WHERE g.first_name ILIKE 'gina' AND g.last_name ILIKE 'degeneres' AND a.actor_id <> g.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fa2.film_id) >= 4

question: For each customer of store 2, what is the average number of days between consecutive rentals?
sql: WITH g AS (SELECT customer_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rental_date - LAG(rental_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY rental_date, rental_id))) / 86400 AS days FROM rental WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer WHERE store_id = 2)) SELECT customer_id, ROUND(AVG(days)::numeric, 2) FROM g GROUP BY customer_id

question: What are the three highest-earning PG-13 films by total payments?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id WHERE f.rating = 'PG-13' GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC, f.film_id LIMIT 3

question: How many actors appear in more films than the average actor does?
